description: A directed edge (connection) between two nodes on the canvas.

members.name: IsValid
members.description: Validates that at least one end of the edge is connected (to a node or edge) or has an absolute point.

members.name: ArcSize
members.description: Corner radius in pixels for rounded edges. Null = use default (8px).

members.name: ConnectorType
members.description: Connector semantic type. (e.g. "association", "inheritance", "dependency", "composition", "aggregation").

members.name: CubicBezier
members.description: Whether curved routing uses cubic Bézier (C command) instead of quadratic (Q command).

members.name: ElbowOrientation
members.description: Elbow orientation. "auto" (default), "horizontal" (horizontal-first L-shape), or "vertical" (vertical-first L-shape).

members.name: EndArrow
members.description: End arrowhead style. Supported: none, classic, block, open, oval, diamond, async.

members.name: EndArrowFill
members.description: Whether the end arrowhead is filled. Null = use default based on arrowhead type.

members.name: EndArrowSize
members.description: End arrowhead size in pixels.

members.name: Id
members.description: Unique identifier (short Guid, e.g. "a3f8c21b").

members.name: IsManuallyRouted
members.description: Whether this edge uses manually placed waypoints and should not be auto-routed.

members.name: JumpSize
members.description: Line jump size in pixels.

members.name: JumpStyle
members.description: Line jump style when edges cross. Supported: arc, gap, sharp, line.

members.name: Label
members.description: Optional label rendered along the connector path.

members.name: LabelOffsetX
members.description: Horizontal offset of the label from the point on the edge path (px).

members.name: LabelOffsetY
members.description: Vertical offset of the label from the point on the edge path (px).

members.name: LabelPositionT
members.description: Label position along the edge path as parameter t (0-1). Default 0.5.

members.name: LayerId
members.description: Optional layer identifier. When null, the edge belongs to the default layer.

members.name: Link
members.description: Optional hyperlink target (external URL or page:// link).

members.name: LockedBy
members.description: Reserved for future collaborative editing – who has this edge locked.

members.name: Rounded
members.description: Whether to use rounded corners on the edge path.

members.name: Routing
members.description: Edge routing type. Supported: "straight", "orthogonal", "elbow", "segment", "curved".

members.name: Shape
members.description: Edge shape type. Supported: "connector", "link", "filledEdge", "pipe", "wire".

members.name: SourceCardinality
members.description: Source cardinality for ER diagrams.

members.name: SourceConstraint
members.description: Source connection constraint. When set, overrides port-based connection.

members.name: SourceEdgeId
members.description: Optional source edge identifier (for edge-to-edge connections).

members.name: SourceEdgeT
members.description: Parameter t (0-1) along the source edge for edge-to-edge connections.

members.name: SourceNodeId
members.description: Source node identifier. Null when the edge has a free-floating source.

members.name: SourcePoint
members.description: Absolute position of the free-floating source point. Used when SourceNodeId is null.

members.name: SourcePortId
members.description: Optional source port identifier.

members.name: SourceSpacing
members.description: Spacing between source node boundary and edge start.

members.name: StartArrow
members.description: Start arrowhead style. Supported: none, classic, block, open, oval, diamond, async.

members.name: StartArrowFill
members.description: Whether the start arrowhead is filled. Null = use default based on arrowhead type.

members.name: StartArrowSize
members.description: Start arrowhead size in pixels.

members.name: Style
members.description: Visual style overrides for this edge.

members.name: TargetCardinality
members.description: Target cardinality for ER diagrams.

members.name: TargetConstraint
members.description: Target connection constraint. When set, overrides port-based connection.

members.name: TargetEdgeId
members.description: Optional target edge identifier (for edge-to-edge connections).

members.name: TargetEdgeT
members.description: Parameter t (0-1) along the target edge for edge-to-edge connections.

members.name: TargetNodeId
members.description: Target node identifier. Null when the edge has a free-floating target.

members.name: TargetPoint
members.description: Absolute position of the free-floating target point. Used when TargetNodeId is null.

members.name: TargetPortId
members.description: Optional target port identifier.

members.name: TargetSpacing
members.description: Spacing between target node boundary and edge end.

members.name: Waypoints
members.description: Intermediate waypoints for the edge path. Empty for straight lines.

members.name: ZIndex
members.description: Z-order index for edge layering. Higher values render on top.
